pointInTimePolicy.forecastCutoff: 09:00 ET on the calendar day after the final NFL kickoff assigned to the completed week.
pointInTimePolicy.matchupAnchor: The finalized Sleeper matchup players list, treated as authoritative through six hours after the final kickoff.
pointInTimePolicy.transactionTimestamp: status_updated is the effective time; created is used only when status_updated is absent.
pointInTimePolicy.transactionFilter: Only status=complete mutations after the estimated matchup anchor and at or before the forecast cutoff are applied.

limitations: Sleeper matchup rows do not include a snapshot timestamp. The six-hour post-kickoff anchor is an explicit conservative assumption, not a fact supplied by Sleeper.
The players list is the finalized roster attached to that matchup. It may not reproduce intraday roster state before every individual NFL game lock.
Transactions after the cutoff are intentionally excluded even if they appear in the following week matchup.
created is submission time and can predate waiver or trade completion; rows requiring that fallback are counted in every audit.
Draft picks and traded draft picks do not change the current player roster and are preserved only in Sleeper, not replayed here.
This artifact is an auditable research input and does not alter production simulation probabilities.
